facts.business: Harikanta Overseas Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of synthetic and value-added textile fabrics including Ikat fabrics, polyester garment fabrics, sarees, Dhupion fabrics, viscose, natural-fibre fabrics and Poly Linen for domestic and international markets.
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions entered into during the financial year were on at Arm Length basis and in the ordinary course of business. There were no material related party transactions made by the company with related parties which may have potential conflict with the interest of the company at large. Details of Related party transactions as required under AS-18 are provided in note 26 to financial statements.
